ov: Large waterfowl, between ducks and swans in size. Most wild species migrate, and domestic geese come from the wild greylag goose and swan goose.

why.dg: Geese are highly aggressive and noisy when they feel threatened, and ganders stand between a threat and their family.
why.dm: Wild geese aren’t domesticated, but domestic geese were bred from the greylag and swan goose.

cf.tip: Ducks, geese and swans are one family. Ducks are generally smaller and shorter-necked than geese and swans.

fx: Geese have been used as guards: in the late 1950s, South Vietnam’s air force kept flocks to raise the alarm at intruders near parked aircraft.
